topic: Rich model detail versus field performance
segments: BIM/VDC wants detail; field and mobile users need bounded interaction
reason: Different devices and tasks tolerate different geometry budgets
decision: Lazy-load 3D, cap DPR at 2, use plan-controlled massing and progressive layers, keep a nonvisual register
validation: Measure on target tablets and run context-loss/long-session tests; still UNVERIFIED

topic: Automatic AI takeoff versus estimator trust
segments: Owners value speed; estimators require reviewable quantities and source lineage
reason: Automation helps document interrogation but fails when presented as authoritative
decision: Use editable material assumptions and explicit basis/confidence; exclude labor and do not claim one-click accuracy
validation: Estimator-reviewed plan-to-estimate sample; representative-user test UNVERIFIED

topic: GIS parcel convenience versus survey authority
segments: PMs want context; survey/BIM users need legal and coordinate precision
reason: Authoritative GIS is useful reference evidence but not necessarily legal-survey accuracy
decision: Keep parcel/frontage gate closed until official records reconcile; label plan-sourced lines and IDs
validation: Official APN/boundary/frontage query plus CRS comparison; blocked

topic: Canvas exception to reflow versus reachable controls
segments: 3D requires two dimensions; keyboard/zoom users still need reachable UI
reason: WCAG permits spatial exceptions but not offscreen surrounding controls
decision: Viewport-bound canvas with internally scrolling rails, bottom sheets and verification table
validation: 320–1920 px and 200% zoom rendered matrix; UNVERIFIED

topic: Cumulative 4D build versus isolated current work
segments: Executives explain sequence cumulatively; trades isolate current scope
decision: Provide cumulative and current-stage modes; stage 12 always shows the coordinated completion
validation: Pure object visibility tests pass; rendered playback pending

segments: Fast users value immediacy; all users reject false success and lost work
reason: Optimism is safe only with visible unsynced state and reconciliation
decision: Confirm server response before success; use idempotency/compensation for upload; local viewer prefs recover independently
validation: Pure retry tests pass; hosted D1/R2 fault drill pending

segments: Power users want direct tools; first-time and mobile users need labels and focus
reason: Dense icon-only controls lower discoverability and can overflow
decision: Exactly 12 labeled tools with tooltips, active/disabled states and mobile horizontal docking
validation: Static inventory passes; first-time/device tests UNVERIFIED

topic: Live external actions versus truthful local workflow
segments: Growth users expect automation; operators need delivery and failure evidence
reason: Credentials/providers are absent, so pretending to send would create false success
decision: Persist CRM/campaign/payment records locally, label catalog benchmarks, export ICS, and do not claim two-way messaging/calendar/payment
validation: Source copy audit and API persistence tests; external integrations deferred

topic: Public health detail versus operational diagnosis
segments: Operators need dependency state; attackers should not receive internals
reason: Health endpoints can aid both diagnosis and reconnaissance
decision: Return only ready/failed, latency and opaque request ID; log no plan data or raw error
validation: Health source/build tests pass; monitoring access review pending

topic: Exact footprint appearance versus evidence limits
segments: Presentation users value recognizable geometry; field users require dimensional truth
reason: The supplied set contains explicit controls but unresolved parcel and irregular-footprint reconciliation
decision: Render a provisional source-linked construction model, visibly close field-use gate, and never reuse it for another house
validation: Six explicit checks pass; three controlling relationships remain UNVERIFIED
